blocks.label: Encounter Label
blocks.text: Fictional gameplay

blocks.text: Aelia is a fictional freedwoman: she was enslaved and was later freed.

blocks.label: Claim
blocks.text: Naevoleia Tyche’s commemorative monument and inscription identify her as a freedwoman.

blocks.label: Evidence
blocks.text: The Park discusses the inscription on the monument near the Herculaneum Gate. That monument is outside this game district.

blocks.label: Limits
blocks.text: One prominent monument cannot show how every freedwoman lived. Women had varied social statuses and opportunities. The Park’s imagined first-person narration is modern interpretation.

blocks.text: Aelia is not Naevoleia Tyche. Her money, work, access and choices are fictional simplifications, not general Roman legal rights.

blocks.label: Question
